title: provisioned throughput replay, agent traffic shape
label: Built to a profile of stated figures rather than a measured dataset. Replace the profile with one derived from your own logs. Raise rate_scale stepwise (0.1 -> 0.25 -> 0.5 -> 1.0) per the run plan in docs/PRODUCTION_TESTING.md. max_concurrency is sized for the final rate_scale step: 500 QPS at a ~2s p95 needs ~1000 in flight, so 2048 leaves headroom. Undersizing it makes the client the bottleneck and the report will say so. A single process bends near 270 requests/second, so the last rate_scale step needs the schedule sharded across machines, see PRODUCTION_TESTING.
